function: Self-supervised DNN designs digital and analog precoders, antenna selection, RF-chain connections and power allocation to maximise energy efficiency of fully digital and hybrid beamforming (pp. 1, 8-9).
system: Single-cell TDD massive MIMO BS, NT=64 antennas, NRF=8 RF chains, NU=4 single-antenna users; no RIS; mmWave 28 GHz DeepMIMO scenario (pp. 4, 11-12).
method: Self-supervised (unsupervised) CNN+FC DNN; loss combines energy consumption and spectral efficiency; Gumbel-Sigmoid for binary connections; trained on imperfect CSI with AdamW (pp. 8-11).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing scenario O1-28 GHz, 2x10^6 samples of random 4-user location sets; imperfect CSI (error factor beta) used for training and testing (pp. 5-6, 11).
test_conditions: Same O1 scenario, area S1: 85% of samples train, rest test; active users random in training; DNN trained with each CSI-error beta and rate Rd (pp. 9-11, 14).
baselines: Non-learned: near-optimal FDP, WMMSE, PE-AltMin, MO-AltMin (FC-HBF), DSA-HBF, FSA-HBF; learned: FC-HBF-Net [32], the authors' earlier unsupervised DNN for hybrid beamforming (pp. 4-5, 12).
metrics: Spectral efficiency (b/s/Hz), power consumption (W), energy efficiency (b/s/Hz/W), active RF chains, SE loss versus CSI error, real multiplications (pp. 12-15).
complexity: Analytical real multiplications (Table 7): E-HBF-Net 5.21e8 vs PE-AltMin 8.48e8, MO-AltMin 38.7e8; E-FDP-Net 4.69e8 vs near-optimal FDP 7.27e8; 5.8M and 4.9M parameters (pp. 8, 15).
openness: none: no link to own code or data; uses the public DeepMIMO dataset [35] (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 11: "deepMIMO channel model [35] is employed to generate the unlabeled dataset" for training and testing (scenario O1-28 GHz, DeepMIMO ray tracing).
q2_support: p. 11: "85% of the samples used for the training set and the remaining used to evaluate the performance", one scenario and area S1; p. 9: users "selected uniformly at random during training". No unseen scenario, band, array or user count.
q3_support: p. 12: "conventional non-DL approaches FDP, WMMSE [52], MO-AltMin, PE-AltMin" and "DL-based solution FC-HBF-Net [32]", compared on spectral efficiency (Fig. 8); [32] is the authors' earlier HBF network (p. 16).
q4_support: p. 15: "reduces the complexity by 38% compared to the least complex conventional approach (PE-AltMin)"; Table 7 gives real multiplications (5.21e8 E-HBF-Net, 4.69e8 E-FDP-Net); p. 8: 5.8M and 4.9M parameters.
q5_support: p. 11: "deepMIMO channel model [35] is employed to generate the unlabeled dataset"; public DeepMIMO channels for training and testing. No link to the authors' own code or data found.
notes: Area 3: the DNN outputs the precoders (digital precoder, analog phase shifters) together with antenna and RF-chain selection, so it designs beamforming, not antenna hardware; borderline for the function check, reviewer to confirm. DeepMIMO counted for q1 and q5. q2 is 0: Fig. 13 user counts lie inside the training range and the CSI-error sweep is a sweep. [32] is the same authors' GLOBECOM 2022 paper.
